title: 第485章 千呼万唤始出来
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
林雲的出现让欧阳冷傲、姑苏明月的战斗停止了下来。众人见到欧阳冷傲、姑苏明月反应，当即意识到此人身份的不简单。
“快看那个新娘，刚刚欧阳冷傲挑战各大家族的时候，新娘全程坐着没有动，现在却站了起来！”
在场的众人可都是修行者武者，无论是视觉或者听觉都远非常人可以比。林雲出现后发生的事情众人也是有目共睹。
擂台之上，欧阳冷傲的双眼死死的盯着林雲，早已经忘记自己此刻是在与姑苏明月挑战了。
姑苏明月倒也不介意，自己本来就对欧阳冷傲的实力不感兴趣。既然林雲出现在欧阳山庄，自己的目的就已经达到了。
“欧阳冷傲，想必这擂台不需我了，小女子还是将它留给你想要的人吧！”姑苏明月这才说着离开擂台。
欧阳冷傲没有反对，以万宝阁的暗网情报，自然能够收集到林雲与自己的关系。姑苏明月将擂台留给林雲，并没有让欧阳冷傲察觉出什么异常。
在众人的目光锁定之中，林雲丝毫没有半点避讳，直接朝着高台之上的上官玉儿说道：“上官玉儿你放心，我马上就会带你走！”
“以上官玉儿的容貌，有个痴心的追求者也算是正常。但这里是欧阳山庄，这家伙竟然敢独闯欧阳山庄，实在是太大胆了！”
姑苏明月脸上露出一丝不悦，这个薄情的负心汉，难道没有看到老娘为了帮他拖延时间，甚至都亲自出马了吗？
“林雲？”欧阳庄主从欧阳冷傲的反应中，猜测出眼前这少年的身份。
content_en:
Lin Yun's appearance stopped the fighting between Ouyang Lengao and Gusu Mingyue. When everyone saw the reactions of Ouyang Lengao and Gusu Mingyue, they immediately realized that this person's identity was not simple.
"Look at that bride. When Ouyang Lengao challenged the major families just now, the bride sat motionless the whole time, but now she stands up!"
Everyone present is a cultivator and warrior, and their vision and hearing are far superior to those of ordinary people. What happened after Lin Yun appeared was obvious to everyone.
On the ring, Ouyang Lengao's eyes were fixed on Lin Yun, and he had already forgotten that he was challenging Gusu Mingyue at this moment.
Gusu Mingyue didn't mind, as she was not interested in Ouyang Lengao's strength. Now that Lin Yun appears in Ouyang Villa, his goal has been achieved.
"Ouyang Lengao, I guess you don't need me in this arena anymore. Little lady, you should leave it to the person you want!" Gusu Mingyue said and left the arena.
Ouyang Lengao had no objection. With Wanbao Pavilion's dark web intelligence, he was naturally able to collect the relationship between Lin Yun and himself. Gusu Mingyue left the arena to Lin Yun, but Ouyang Lengao did not notice anything unusual.
With everyone's eyes locked, Lin Yun didn't shy away at all, and said directly to Shangguan Yu'er on the high platform: "Don't worry, Shangguan Yu'er, I will take you away right away!"
"With Shangguan Yu'er's appearance, it is normal to have an infatuated suitor. But this is Ouyang Villa, and this guy dares to enter Ouyang Villa alone. He is really bold!"
There was a trace of displeasure on Gusu Mingyue's face. Didn't this heartless and heartless man see that my mother even took action herself in order to delay time for him?
"Lin Yun?" Master Ouyang guessed the identity of the young man in front of him from Ouyang Lengao's reaction.
